items.summary: Reporter: Cavan Loughran, Celvex Group Inc. An empty HMAC key produces a deterministic digest that any party can reproduce, so an attacker who knows (or can cause) the application to verify a token with an empty key can forge arbitrary tokens that pass HS256/HS384/HS512 signature verification. items.title: Authlib: ID token can disable its own nonce validation via the nonce_supported claim
items.summary: ### Summary `OpenIDMixin.parse_id_token()` reads the `nonce_supported` claim from the ID token it is validating. When that claim is boolean `false`, the expected nonce is set to `None` and nonce validation is skipped for that token. An ID token that carries this claim is therefore accepted in a session whose nonce does not match.
